## Standing note

Item tags are **Trial** (sandbox, demo, one-off, MoU or signing) or **Operating** (recurring public or commercial service). Sandbox counts and corridor status live on [Official status](tracker.qmd). Item lines below focus on the use case — they do not restate those baselines.

## How to read the source tags

- **Company-announced:** the company’s own claim.
- **Independently reported:** a news outlet’s own reporting.
- **Officially confirmed:** confirmed in a linked official release or document.

**As of 11 Oct 2026:** 52 use-case items on this page (38 trial · 14 operating). Live window colour draws on the Sep–Oct 2026 snapshot; the archive covers Oct 2025 onward, plus earlier public-service items.

[C114](https://m.c114.com.cn/w84-1318768.html)
  - Status: **Trial** · Domain: Delivery · Geography: GBA (Zhuhai)
  - Tag: Company-announced
  - What's happening: Signing / pilot-preparation via the Unicom feature. Stated division of labour and 5G + BeiDou framing are plans. Route count, aircraft type, payload and frequency are not published.
  - Note: Strategic cooperation only — not live commercial island routes.
  - Read instead: None.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}

[浙江在线](https://zjnews.zjol.com.cn/zjnews/202610/t20261007_31951269.shtml)
  - Status: **Operating** · Domain: Delivery · Geography: Mainland-other (Hangzhou)
  - Tag: Independently reported
  - What's happening: South-bank → Shangcheng receiving-point colour (~10+ minutes, ~100 m AGL). Cargo mix mainly business express, fresh goods, emergency medicines and digital accessories. Cumulative company scale claims in the same piece stay company-announced.

### May 2025 {#uc-2025-05}

LCQ: assisted detection of four cases / three arrests since May; annex lists HKPF fleet/task counts for H1 2025. [Offbeat](https://www.police.gov.hk/offbeat/1282/chi/9022.html) · [Police EN](https://www.police.gov.hk/ppp_en/11_useful_info/ps_odd.html) · [LCQ EN](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/30/P2025073000346.htm)
  - Status: **Trial** · Domain: Public service · Geography: HK
  - Tag: Officially confirmed
  - What's happening: Time-bounded Pilot Scheme with privacy signage and Advanced-Rating pilots. Cite only stated purposes (border path patrol; high-altitude anti-crime patrol; case-detection colour in LCQ). Fleet/task annex figures are officially published counts.

  - Read instead: None.

  ::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="Official English"}
  > Starting from 2025-05-23, the first phase of the pilot scheme was implemented in two trial locations: utilizing an automated drone docking system for patrols in the Border District … and conducting high-altitude patrols in the downtown areas of the Kowloon West Region through manual flight mode… Since the launch of the Pilot Scheme in May, the use of drones has assisted the Police in detecting four cases so far, with three persons arrested.
